params.node: The namehash of the agent's ENS name.

params.nullifierHash: The World ID nullifier hash proving uniqueness.

RESOLVER().notice: The ENSv2 PermissionedResolver that holds agent records.

VERIFIER().notice: The address allowed to set verification status (the platform backend).

ensureHumanVerifiedRecord(bytes32,bytes).notice: (Re)write the `human-verified` text record for an agent name. This is         permissioned via EAC so that ONLY this contract (holding `ROLE_SET_TEXT`         on the "human-verified" key) actually succeeds. Non-permitted callers revert.

isHumanVerified(address).notice: Check whether an address is a verified human.

nullifiers(address).notice: Nullifier hashes keyed by address, to detect sybil reuse.

verifyHuman(address,uint256).notice: Set a human as verified after they pass World Selfie Check.
